title: Dactyl Issue 77 direct SQLite connector completion
intent: Complete the Dactyl-owned remainder of Issue 77: provide the minimal private runtime-loaded host SQLite connector, remove stale snapshot/import semantics and unnecessary implementation paths, preserve the backend-neutral API and local SQLite compatibility, and publish one dedicated PR.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --check; cargo test --all-features; cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo tree --all-features; readelf -d target/debug/deps/*dactyl* | grep sqlite3; decapod validate
stop_conditions: No bundled SQLite, rusqlite, libsqlite3-sys, public backend handle, or silent snapshot fallback.
